name: Kikura Shioji
source: [url=/c17072]Yume's[/url] bodyguard. She is strict at herself and can sometimes be overprotective. She doesn't really care about men but she enjoys the popularity she has gained by teasing masochistic boys. Shioji lives by the motto "Milady's happiness is also my happiness", showing how loyal she is towards her.
